_comment: Craft action choices. Ported from User#get_craft_choices + the CRAFTING_COST constants (ItemCraftingCost). The Rails IrradiationEnclosure (100 wood + 100 iron) is split into carbon and iron variants; their costs are placeholder tuning. Radiation source costs are placeholder tuning too.

recipes.label: Loot Box
recipes.tooltip: Compress raw matter into a sealed loot box.

recipes.label: Grow Lamp
recipes.tooltip: A broad-spectrum lamp. Visible light drives photosynthesis: loot boxes yield more carbon.

recipes.label: Infrared Emitter
recipes.tooltip: Heats and cures what it shines on: loot boxes get extra rolls.

recipes.label: Microwave Emitter
recipes.tooltip: Shakes ore loose: iron becomes more likely in loot boxes.

recipes.label: X-Ray Tube
recipes.tooltip: Inspection: reveals a loot box's contents and locks them in. Nothing changes the box after that.

recipes.label: Gamma Source
recipes.tooltip: Mutation: loot boxes may contain loot boxes. Needs an iron enclosure.
